en: If this truly is the will of mankind, then{SAUT}I ask that you prove it to be so.
Moreover, you must not forget...{PAGE}I appeared in this form solely due to{SAUT}the desires of humans.{PAGE}As long as humans yearn for me, I shall{SAUT}appear as many times as necessary.
It's really, finally over for sure this{SAUT}time.
